plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. While collusion *could* be profitable, it's risky with unknown opponents and a single round. Bidding my value of $48 maximizes my expected profit, as it ensures I win whenever my value is higher than the second-highest value, and I only pay a price reflecting another bidder's valuation. I will therefore bid my value.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you win if and only if your bid is the highest, and you pay the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values it more, while bidding more than your value risks paying more than the item is worth to you. Therefore, I will bid my value of $38.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you want to win only if the prize is worth more to you than to the other bidders, and you only pay the second-highest bid, so there's no downside to revealing your true valuation. My value is $12, so I will bid $12.
